policies.title: Hybrid and Remote Work Policy 2026
policies.summary: Regular full-time employees are eligible for hybrid work requiring a minimum of two designated in-office collaborative days per week (Tuesdays and Thursdays), with up to three remote days upon direct manager approval.

policies.title: Paid Parental Leave Policy 2026
policies.summary: Full-time regular employees are eligible for up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child, to be taken within the first 12 months.

policies.title: Employee Education & Tuition Assistance Policy
policies.summary: Full-time employees with at least 6 months of tenure can receive up to $5,250 annually for accredited degree coursework, certifications, and technical conferences, subject to manager pre-approval and a passing grade of 'B' or higher.

policies.title: Medical Leave of Absence (FMLA) Guide
policies.submission_window: Submit via HR Portal at least 30 days in advance of planned leave.

policies.title: Contoso Acceptable Use Policy v4
policies.summary: Governs acceptable usage of corporate hardware, software, cloud accounts, and data assets.

policies.title: Security Incident Reporting & Escalation SOP
steps: 1. Identification: Detect and log anomalous activity via SIEM alerts.
2. Immediate Containment: Isolate affected host/account within 15 minutes of triage.
3. Escalation: Page the On-Call Incident Commander via PagerDuty.
4. Eradication & Recovery: Deploy verified remediation patches and restore clean backups.
5. Post-Incident Review: Publish blameless Root Cause Analysis (RCA) within 72 hours.

policies.title: Approved Third-Party AI Tool Whitelist & GenAI Usage
policies.summary: Defines enterprise guidelines for using Google Gemini Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot; prohibits inputting confidential customer data into unapproved external LLMs.

active_initiatives: Phasing out legacy hardware tokens in favor of FIDO2 WebAuthn biometric keys

procedures.title: Badge & Smartcard Replacement Procedure
procedures.summary: Submit a ServiceNow Service Request under 'Physical Security > Badge Replacement' (Form SEC-4001), obtain manager sign-off, and pick up the new badge with government-issued photo ID at the Security Operations Desk in Building B, 1st Floor.

sites.point_of_contact: Elena Rostova (Director of Finance Operations), travel-expenses@contoso.com

policies.title: Corporate Travel & Expense Policy 2026
policies.summary: Domestic travel per diem capped at $75/day without overnight stay. Permits up to $60/day for mobile broadband hotspots during business travel.
